entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Blazor WebAssembly fails to hydrate when "build --no-restore" #32911
  • Apple Intelligence schema responses require additional parameters #32909
  • Apple Intelligence streaming schema responses are not raw json #32908
  • [iOS] Horizontal CollectionView ignores FlowDirection.RightToLeft in MAUI 10 #32906
  • [XSG] Improve diagnostic reporting during binding compilation #32904
  • Slider Binding Initialization Order Causes Incorrect Value Assignment in XAML #32903
  • [MacOS 26] 'Search Recipe' and 'My Recipe' tab are missing on MacOS Tahoe 26.1 #32900
  • [NET 10] G8 - Dotnet bot image is not showing up when using iOS 26 and macOS 26.1 #32899

Closed

  • Value attribute isn't valid XAML syntax but doesn't produce error #29422
    Backlog
  • XamlC error : Value cannot be null. (Parameter 'key') #24472
    Backlog
  • [Proposal][XSG] Use heuristic to identify bindable properties generated by another source generator #32596
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Style with setter on AbsoluteLayout.LayoutBounds and SourceGen fails #32879
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • I can' upload my app to the Microsoft Store, because the Package Family Name (PFN) and the Publisher is wrong in the .msix file #32801
  • XAML source generator error #32901
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • can not load image in publish environment #32347
    Backlog
  • CollectionView DataTemplate with Switch: Toggled event is called in infinite loop causing app to crash. #32096
  • With the light theme enabled, the underlined lines in the ENTRY control have disappeared #32685
  • MAUI [.NET10] Shell navigation issue #32705
  • Control is clipped under the status bar when set the SafeAreaEdges = None. #32527
  • NET10 upgrade error - 'TemplatedView.Children' is obsolete: 'Use IVisualTreeElement.GetVisualChildren() instead.' #32598
  • iOS: Label inside Border disappears #32737
  • .net 10 maui regression - hang #32686

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix binding to interface-inherited properties like IReadOnlyList<T>.Count #32912
  • [Issue-Resolver] Fix TabBar visibility on macOS 26 (Tahoe) #32910
    platform/macos, area-controls-shell, area-controls-tabbedpage, community ✨
  • [Issue-Resolver] Fix #32903 - Sliderbinding initialization order issue #32907
    platform/ios, area-controls-slider
  • [XSG] Improve diagnostic reporting during binding compilation #32905

Merged

  • Detect and report warning when property elements have attributes #32896
    area-xaml, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [XSG] Add NullExtension shortcut to SourceGen #32892
    area-xaml, xsg, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [XC] Fix XamlC null key error in CanAddToResourceDictionary #32902
  • [XSG] Add heuristic to support bindable properties generated by other source generators #32597
  • [XSG] Fix Style setter with content syntax in SourceGen #32890
    area-xaml, xsg, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [Testing] Fixed Test case failure in PR 32841 - [12/01/2025] Candidate #32868
    area-testing, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • Fix NullReferenceException when using x:Name on resources #32897
    area-xaml, .NET 10.0 SR2

Updated

    area-controls-webview
  • Add warning for duplicate property assignments in XAML #32654
    area-xaml, .NET 11 Planning
  • Switch to SLNX and without switching to SLNF #32714
  • [Android] Fixed CollectionView reordering last item #17825
    area-controls-collectionview, community ✨, stale
  • Fix the OnNavigatedTo event and the OnAppearing event to return the ScrollToAsync method call #16619
    community ✨, stale, area-controls-scrollview, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [iOS] SwipeView Closes when Content Changes - right and bottom - fix #30182
    platform/ios, community ✨, area-controls-swipeview, .NET 10.0 SR2

    platform/android, area-controls-shell, partner/syncfusion

    platform/android, area-controls-shell, partner/syncfusion, shell-flyout

  • Rapid change of selected tab results in crash on Windows #32865
